Target load is offered events/sec, not a capacity estimate. Burst offers the same count within the first quarter of the window.

HTTP acknowledgement is measured per successful request, including client encoding/network/broker acknowledgement. No automatic load-driver retries. Visibility percentiles use only first observations made by the pending observer (ObservedEvents), not rows first found by final verification. AmbiguousUnobserved means absent at final bounded verification.

Storage latency is a per-event receipt-to-first-observed-committed-row upper bound. Receipt and SQL clock timestamps share the deployment VM clock; the SQL clock is queried after reading the committed-row result. Includes polling, query and clock-probe delay; persisted_at is not used. Host time only schedules load/backlog.

PersistedEPS = independently verified unique rows / (measured window plus request tail and complete observation/verification drain); accepted EPS counts only acknowledgements completed inside the measured window. Late starts and acknowledgements are reported separately. Limited outcomes are not achieved-load/capacity claims. See raw durations.
ID sets are reconciled in memory; sorted unique IDs joined by newline (no trailing newline) are SHA-256 hashed for bounded public evidence. Recreate IDs from seed plus repetition and event index.
Generator misses mean its bounded queue could not keep up; late schedules count scheduler delays beyond one request interval. Shared-host generator/observer compete with services.

Notes: Availability experiment; not a capacity estimate. Actual control timestamps and reconciled ID sets are retained.
A forced consumer kill does not claim to land in every database/offset commit window; the deterministic crash regression remains separate.

A forced consumer kill does not claim to land in every database/offset commit window; the deterministic crash regression remains separate.
One untimed warm-up order before three measured broker outages.100 pending local events per repetition; the first one-attempt dispatch exceeds the broker publish timeout.
Pending-local samples are observations after commands, not exact transition times. HTTP ACK still precedes PostgreSQL persistence.
Smoke runs verify correctness only. Full runs retain every configured repetition; limited outcomes are not capacity claims.
Raw captures contain empirical samples and UUID population indices (or explicit outbox UUIDs); gzip mtime=0 with SHA256. Submitted IDs regenerate from namespace/seed/index.
Failed and interrupted attempts remain in case History. A resumed incomplete case restarts all three repetitions on a fresh owned stack; completed captures are immutable.
